$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the screen domain after it read the person's open Inbox (`GET /studio-user/v1/me/inbox?view=open`): how many items wait, or null when the read failed. The top bar shows it instead of reading the Inbox itself while such a screen is open, so a visit reads the Inbox once, not twice (#1077). See inboxCountActions.ts.
